_note: M6 deterministic e-Visa pre-check inputs (plan section 4.2). Sources: Indian mission pages; windows differ across pages and years.
apply_max_days_conflict: Sources say 30, 60, 120 or 180 days. Default 120 and tell the user to confirm on indianvisaonline.gov.in.
ineligible: People endorsed on another person's passport
People of Pakistani origin (must apply for a regular visa at a mission)
on_arrival: Carry a Yellow Fever card if arriving from an affected country
Travel on the passport used in the application; carry the old one if the visa was granted on it
